definitions.larva_day_class: the first stage at which the protein chain stopped for that larva on that day (mutually exclusive, in chain order)
definitions.nurse_in_round: a worker with a nest_move event in the nest round
definitions.cache_at_round_start: stores.protein replayed from the start state through the foraging-phase transfers to the first nest-round record

conservation.rule: per colony-day and per compartment (aggregate per kind and per individual id): opening (start state) + in (food_transfer to it) = out (food_transfer from it) + closing (end state); in_transit opens and closes at 0; sinks (metabolized, loss, egg) only receive; world sources are closed by the engine check checkSources (ecology growth is not a food_transfer)

code_facts.fact: one nest round per colony per day (the only route by which food reaches a larva)
only workers with task 'nurse' whose last_location is the nest node take part
a nurse takes at most take_from_cache_max_portions (0.28, game assumption) once per round, limited by its crop room
one take per nurse per round is enforced by the engine check
the queen leg comes BEFORE the brood leg; up to feed_max_portions_per_contact (0.28) liquid protein goes to the queen first
the brood leg runs after the queen leg
each nurse meets exactly ONE larva per round (uniform draw among larvae at the brood place)
at most one fixed bolus per food per contact (protein bolus 0.08 = larva_protein_daily at the reference temperature)
larval need scales with the metabolic factor (Q10) while the bolus is fixed: one feeding cannot meet need above the reference temperature
liquid protein still held at the end of the round goes back to the store (crops hold none overnight)
one task per worker per day from a weighted lottery; nurse weight 0.25 × (1 + 0.65 × own begging cue) (game assumptions)
the task lottery is drawn for every worker every day (no persistence)
the begging CUE contact is a second, independent draw (probability 0.75) — not the feeding contact; the larva that sets the cue need not be the larva fed
protein store capacity 12 + 0.3 per worker above 14 (game assumptions); the excess is lost
under C4a the colony protein fraction no longer includes the larvae (servedLarvae = 0)
without C4b a larva develops from the COLONY fractions min(pFraction, sFraction) (L2, colony total into an individual)
larval starvation death uses the COLONY protein_gap_days (L3, colony total into an individual; C4c pending)
care for brood = whether the colony had ANY worker at the start of the step (not individual contact)

locality_audit.note: own crop fill, own contact impressions (local_sensory), own age and injury, weather; no colony total
draws one larva (all larvae of the colony when v31 is off; only the brood place when on); no colony total

the amount taken is min(cap, own crop room, colony.stores.protein): the nurse perceives the store it stands at; with ONE store per nest that store IS the colony protein total (stated equivalence, design C3a); stores.sugar is only decremented (bookkeeping)

locality_audit.role: nurse meets and feeds one larva
locality_audit.note: larva begging, threshold, own crop; here.length is the denominator of the uniform draw among larvae at the same place (D7 dilution, local); stores.sugar only decremented
own fed_balance, own intake, own need; no colony total
READS colony totals into individual development (ratios, L2 without C4b) and death (protein_gap_days, L3); care = whether the colony had any worker (C4b §4) — known defects Issue #43 A08 / C4c
